content.text:
Start at https://www.google.com and complete the following task.

I’m trying to sanity-check whether moving ahead with a Tesla Model 3 lease in Los Angeles is actually manageable month to month, so start on Google and look up current Tesla Model 3 lease pricing for the Los Angeles area, including the lease term, due-at-signing amount, and any discounts, tax credits, or rebates you can find, because I want a realistic baseline instead of just a headline number. Once you’ve got that monthly lease figure, use it as a reference point and go to the Los Angeles Craigslist site, specifically the San Gabriel Valley section, and find at least three trailer listings that look like plausible live-in fallback options under $10,000; open the actual posting pages in separate tabs so I can see the photos and verify the listings are still live, then note each one’s title, price, and location. After that, go to Zillow and look for an LA-area rental whose monthly price is in the same ballpark as the Tesla lease payment you found, so I can compare whether paying for housing at that level makes more sense than taking on the car; open the actual Zillow listing page and leave it open so I can check the photos and map myself. In the end, give me a short comparison that includes the Tesla lease deal, the three Craigslist trailer backups, and the Zillow rental option that’s closest in monthly price to the lease.

Rules:
- You may use search engines and open new tabs. When the task asks you to leave a page open, keep it open in its own tab and say in your final answer which page is in which tab.
- Do NOT use cached/archived copies of pages (e.g. web.archive.org); work from the live sites.
- If a site you need is blocked (bot check, login wall, error), first try to get through it — complete a bot check yourself, retry, or use another route to the same page. If it still cannot be reached, say so explicitly in your answer and do not fill in from memory what you could not read on the page.
- When the task is complete, give your final answer as plain text in your last message.

content.text:
### 1. Tesla Model 3 Lease Pricing (Los Angeles, CA - ZIP 90012)
*Note on initial search:* Google Search immediately served an automated query reCAPTCHA block on this network IP, so pricing and financing calculations were retrieved directly from the live Tesla Model 3 Design Studio with Los Angeles delivery selected.

* **Model:** Tesla Model 3 Rear-Wheel Drive (Standard Stealth Grey, 18'' Prismata wheels)
* **Lease Term:** 36 months / 10,000 miles per year
* **Headline / Advertised Figures (Excludes Taxes & Non-Tesla Fees):**
  * Monthly Payment: $419 / month
  * Due at Delivery: $4,114 (includes $3,000 down payment, $419 first month's payment, $695 acquisition fee)
* **Realistic Baseline (Includes Estimated Los Angeles Taxes & Government Fees):**
  * Monthly Payment: **$468 / month** (or **$565 / month** with $0 down payment)
  * Due at Delivery: **$5,137** (includes $3,000 down payment, $468 first month payment, $695 acquisition fee, $320 registration, $250 license fee, $37 electronic filing fee, $7 tire fee, and $360.29 upfront tax)
* **Credits, Rebates & Incentives:**
  * **Federal Clean Vehicle Lease Incentive ($7,500):** Factored directly into the lease calculation by Tesla Finance to lower the monthly payment (unlike retail purchase credits, which have stricter battery sourcing rules).
  * **American Heroes Program:** $500 discount for military, first responders, teachers, healthcare workers, and students (verified via ID.me).
  * **Operational Savings:** Estimated $3,000 3-year gas savings compared to a conventional gas vehicle.
  * **End of Lease Terms:** $395 disposition fee; buyout option at $23,796 plus fees. Excess mileage fee: $0.25/mile.

---

### 2. San Gabriel Valley Craigslist: 3 Live-In Trailer Fallback Options (<$10,000)
All three listings are live on the San Gabriel Valley section of Craigslist and have been opened in separate tabs for viewing photos and verification:

1. **Winnebago Travel Trailer 2106 FBS**
   * **Price:** $8,700
   * **Location:** West Covina (San Gabriel Valley)
   * **Details:** Hard-sided travel trailer with one eating area slide-out, twin beds, full kitchen (3-burner range, propane/electric fridge), efficient furnace, working A/C, dual 12V batteries with roof solar charging, and registration paid through May 2027. Fully outfitted for off-grid/live-in dry camping with hoses, tanks, and accessories included.
   * **Tab:** Tab ID `103795366`

2. **Free Local Delivery Tiny House Travel Trailer (Forest River 5th Wheel)**
   * **Price:** $8,700
   * **Location:** Pomona (San Gabriel Valley)
   * **Details:** Turn-key live-in setup featuring 2 slide-outs, high ceilings, full bathroom, full kitchen, 2 air conditioning units, ceiling fan, sleeps 4+, clean title, and current registration. Free local delivery included.
   * **Tab:** Tab ID `103795367`

3. **2002 Forest River 25-Foot Toy Trailer**
   * **Price:** $7,900
   * **Location:** Claremont (San Gabriel Valley)
   * **Details:** 25-foot live-in travel trailer featuring a front bathroom, built-in generator, awning, and A/C.
   * **Tab:** Tab ID `103795368`

---

### 3. Zillow Los Angeles Rental Option (Closest Monthly Price to Lease)
*Note on Zillow access:* Zillow presented a PerimeterX human challenge overlay on initial navigation, which was cleared directly on the page to access live rental data.

* **Address:** 1447 E 25th St #1, Los Angeles, CA 90011 (Central City / Downtown LA vicinity)
* **Monthly Rent:** **$700 / month** (Total monthly price)
* **Details:**
  * **Type:** Private room in a newer multi-unit home / apartment (1,000 sq ft shared living area).
  * **Inclusions:** **All utilities included in the rent** (water, power, trash).
  * **Terms:** Month-to-month flexibility (1-year maximum listed), no credit check or security deposit required, free application.
  * **Amenities:** In-unit washer and dryer, secure gated entrance, on-site fitness center, and recording studio.
* **Tab:** Tab ID `103795370`

---

### 4. Comparison & Sanity Check Summary

| Option | Upfront / Initial Cost | Monthly Outflow | Asset Equity | Ongoing Overhead & Risks |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tesla Model 3 Lease** | $5,137 due at delivery ($0 down option available) | **$468 - $565 / mo** | None (Lease return or $23.8k buyout) | Comprehensive auto insurance ($150–$300+/mo in LA), registration renewals, charging costs, and $0.25/mi overage fees. |
| **Zillow Rental (1447 E 25th St #1)** | $700 (1st month, no deposit or credit check) | **$700 / mo** | None (Rental housing) | Zero utility bills (all included), fixed roof over your head close to DTLA on a flexible month-to-month term. |
| **Craigslist Trailers ($7,900–$8,700)** | $7,900–$8,700 cash one-time | **$0 / mo fixed** (excluding site rent/fuel) | 100% Owned Vehicle Asset | Requires a tow-capable vehicle, parking/RV pad rent or dispersed camping, propane, and maintenance. |

**Key Takeaway:**
A Model 3 lease in Los Angeles actually demands roughly **$700 to $850/month in total monthly cash flow** once California EV auto insurance and charging are added to the realistic $468–$565 monthly payment, plus over $5,100 upfront. By contrast, paying for a room rental in the LA area at $700/month covers complete shelter with all utilities included for virtually the exact same monthly expenditure as driving the car alone. Meanwhile, purchasing one of the $8,000 San Gabriel Valley trailers represents about 1.5 years worth of lease payments but leaves you owning a tangible, fully debt-free shelter fallback.

Our travel trailer days are over.  The registration is paid to May, 2027.  We purchased this travel trailer about 3 years ago.  The trailer was modified to have “twin” beds and the comfortable chairs for eating.  The trailer pulled easily in my opinion, and always seemed to be in lane behind the truck.   This is a nice trailer with one slide out for the eating area.  There are two propane tanks.  There are two 12v batteries.  However, there is also a solar panel which seems to easily recharge the batteries each day.  The refrigerator will work on propane or electricity, we primarily use propane.  The furnace seems very efficient to me, it will keep the trailer warm even on cold nights.  There is a three-burner range, but only one burner ignites with the spark feature.  There is a TV and a radio set which we’ve never used,

### 1. Tesla Model 3 Lease Pricing (Los Angeles, CA - ZIP 90012)
*Note on initial search:* Google Search immediately served an automated query reCAPTCHA block on this network IP, so pricing and financing calculations were retrieved directly from the live Tesla Model 3 Design Studio with Los Angeles delivery selected.

* **Model:** Tesla Model 3 Rear-Wheel Drive (Standard Stealth Grey, 18'' Prismata wheels)
* **Lease Term:** 36 months / 10,000 miles per year
* **Headline / Advertised Figures (Excludes Taxes & Non-Tesla Fees):**
  * Monthly Payment: $419 / month
  * Due at Delivery: $4,114 (includes $3,000 down payment, $419 first month's payment, $695 acquisition fee)
* **Realistic Baseline (Includes Estimated Los Angeles Taxes & Government Fees):**
  * Monthly Payment: **$468 / month** (or **$565 / month** with $0 down payment)
  * Due at Delivery: **$5,137** (includes $3,000 down payment, $468 first month payment, $695 acquisition fee, $320 registration, $250 license fee, $37 electronic filing fee, $7 tire fee, and $360.29 upfront tax)
* **Credits, Rebates & Incentives:**
  * **Federal Clean Vehicle Lease Incentive ($7,500):** Factored directly into the lease calculation by Tesla Finance to lower the monthly payment (unlike retail purchase credits, which have stricter battery sourcing rules).
  * **American Heroes Program:** $500 discount for military, first responders, teachers, healthcare workers, and students (verified via ID.me).
  * **Operational Savings:** Estimated $3,000 3-year gas savings compared to a conventional gas vehicle.
  * **End of Lease Terms:** $395 disposition fee; buyout option at $23,796 plus fees. Excess mileage fee: $0.25/mile.

---

### 2. San Gabriel Valley Craigslist: 3 Live-In Trailer Fallback Options (<$10,000)
All three listings are live on the San Gabriel Valley section of Craigslist and have been opened in separate tabs for viewing photos and verification:

1. **Winnebago Travel Trailer 2106 FBS**
   * **Price:** $8,700
   * **Location:** West Covina (San Gabriel Valley)
   * **Details:** Hard-sided travel trailer with one eating area slide-out, twin beds, full kitchen (3-burner range, propane/electric fridge), efficient furnace, working A/C, dual 12V batteries with roof solar charging, and registration paid through May 2027. Fully outfitted for off-grid/live-in dry camping with hoses, tanks, and accessories included.
   * **Tab:** Tab ID `103795366`

2. **Free Local Delivery Tiny House Travel Trailer (Forest River 5th Wheel)**
   * **Price:** $8,700
   * **Location:** Pomona (San Gabriel Valley)
   * **Details:** Turn-key live-in setup featuring 2 slide-outs, high ceilings, full bathroom, full kitchen, 2 air conditioning units, ceiling fan, sleeps 4+, clean title, and current registration. Free local delivery included.
   * **Tab:** Tab ID `103795367`

3. **2002 Forest River 25-Foot Toy Trailer**
   * **Price:** $7,900
   * **Location:** Claremont (San Gabriel Valley)
   * **Details:** 25-foot live-in travel trailer featuring a front bathroom, built-in generator, awning, and A/C.
   * **Tab:** Tab ID `103795368`

---

### 3. Zillow Los Angeles Rental Option (Closest Monthly Price to Lease)
*Note on Zillow access:* Zillow presented a PerimeterX human challenge overlay on initial navigation, which was cleared directly on the page to access live rental data.

* **Address:** 1447 E 25th St #1, Los Angeles, CA 90011 (Central City / Downtown LA vicinity)
* **Monthly Rent:** **$700 / month** (Total monthly price)
* **Details:**
  * **Type:** Private room in a newer multi-unit home / apartment (1,000 sq ft shared living area).
  * **Inclusions:** **All utilities included in the rent** (water, power, trash).
  * **Terms:** Month-to-month flexibility (1-year maximum listed), no credit check or security deposit required, free application.
  * **Amenities:** In-unit washer and dryer, secure gated entrance, on-site fitness center, and recording studio.
* **Tab:** Tab ID `103795370`

---

### 4. Comparison & Sanity Check Summary

| Option | Upfront / Initial Cost | Monthly Outflow | Asset Equity | Ongoing Overhead & Risks |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Tesla Model 3 Lease** | $5,137 due at delivery ($0 down option available) | **$468 - $565 / mo** | None (Lease return or $23.8k buyout) | Comprehensive auto insurance ($150–$300+/mo in LA), registration renewals, charging costs, and $0.25/mi overage fees. |
| **Zillow Rental (1447 E 25th St #1)** | $700 (1st month, no deposit or credit check) | **$700 / mo** | None (Rental housing) | Zero utility bills (all included), fixed roof over your head close to DTLA on a flexible month-to-month term. |
| **Craigslist Trailers ($7,900–$8,700)** | $7,900–$8,700 cash one-time | **$0 / mo fixed** (excluding site rent/fuel) | 100% Owned Vehicle Asset | Requires a tow-capable vehicle, parking/RV pad rent or dispersed camping, propane, and maintenance. |

**Key Takeaway:**
A Model 3 lease in Los Angeles actually demands roughly **$700 to $850/month in total monthly cash flow** once California EV auto insurance and charging are added to the realistic $468–$565 monthly payment, plus over $5,100 upfront. By contrast, paying for a room rental in the LA area at $700/month covers complete shelter with all utilities included for virtually the exact same monthly expenditure as driving the car alone. Meanwhile, purchasing one of the $8,000 San Gabriel Valley trailers represents about 1.5 years worth of lease payments but leaves you owning a tangible, fully debt-free shelter fallback.
